title: 第17章 杨康16第18章 杨康17
content_zh:
洪七公确实久经江湖，见多识广，但这样的事情他也没遇到过啊！
平心而论，这件事情他，黄蓉，郭靖都有错，唯一无辜的可能就是那位蒙古公主了！
郭靖黄蓉在知道婚约的情况下相恋本就不对，而他在不知情的时候去桃花岛提亲，这简直是郭靖停妻再娶！
被退亲的人一般情况下都不会有什么好名声，哪怕对方是蒙古公主！
虽然他是事后才知道的，但他是郭靖的师父，也确实要负一定责任！一般提亲前都会问明彼此情况，他在无知无觉中做了一回恶人！想到这，洪七公不由叹了一口气！
看着郭靖黄蓉吵吵闹闹的样子，只觉得头疼！
从郭靖的性子来看，郭母也不会是柔柔弱弱，毫无主见的人，她不会让自己的儿子背负背信弃义的名声！黄蓉又是认准一个人不回头的性子，否则当日就不会顶撞自己的父亲了！蒙古公主对郭靖又是一往情深，怎么可能会退婚，这三个人之间简直是一笔烂账，偏偏自己还无意中做了推手！
更何况郭靖的六个师傅还和桃花岛有仇，更不会自家徒弟娶黄蓉了！
不过最终黄蓉还是凭借着自己的聪明才智将郭靖留在了中原，只不过这样一来，丐帮的事情难免有些分身乏术，丐帮也因此更加混乱了！
黄蓉的手段只能拖延，根本就没有解决问题的根本！别的不说，郭母还在蒙古，郭靖难道还能一辈子不见母亲吗？
可惜郭靖看不明白黄蓉的小手段，但洪七公看得很清楚，黄蓉的性子明显担不起丐帮的未来啊！
想到这些日子黄蓉闹出来的事，洪七公是真的头大！心里不由有些后悔自己当初的匆忙传位了！
杨康对于郭靖黄蓉的现状倒是不关心，毕竟他现在忙的飞起！
西域的商道已经正式打通了，自家儿子也在茁壮成长，大金国力蒸蒸日上，只等一个时机就可以开始最后一步了。
夜晚，欧阳克忙完自己手中的事情，不由看向天上的月亮，心里却是感慨万千！
当日他无所事事，之所以选择加入赵王府，不过是为了在中原闯出一番事业，让叔父看到自己的能力，只是后来的事情发展的太快，让他有些意想不到！
想到这，欧阳克不禁低喃道：“没想到我欧阳克一个江湖浪子，居然也会走到逐鹿天下的道路上！”
不过欧阳克对于现在的生活还是满意的，腿上的伤已经恢复了，武功也更上一层楼，欧阳家也在自己的努力下蒸蒸日上！
欧阳克现在就剩下两个目标，一是将白驼山庄做大做强，还有一个就是向郭靖黄蓉复仇！
欧阳克可不是什么以德报怨的正人君子，白驼山庄一贯的作风就是有仇必报！当日断腿的绝望他从未忘记过，最近郭靖黄蓉的鸡飞狗跳也有他的手笔，只不过没人发现而已！

就在这个时候，突然传出了蒙古和大宋要联手灭金的消息，这让大宋不少有识之士感到了山雨欲来风满楼！当日联金灭辽，大宋已经成功丢失了长江以北，如今又来一个联蒙灭金，大宋还能有以后吗？唇亡齿寒啊！
其实铁木真也不想在这个时候和大宋联合的，但是没办法，实在是大金的实力增长的太快了！在这么发展下去，蒙古的盐铁茶都会受制于金国，到时候再想做些什么就晚了！
大宋不知道唇亡齿寒吗？肯定是知道的，毕竟先辈的教训已经摆在了那里！
但即使不与蒙古联合，大金也不会放过他们的啊！原来的金国还需要在大宋买粮来维持国内的稳定，但随着西域商道的开通，大金已经摆脱了这样的局面，现在的大宋简直是进退维谷！还不如和蒙古一起拼一把呢！
随着宋蒙联合抗金的消息传出，江湖朝堂瞬间都安静了下来！有见识的人自然知道此举的危害，没见识的只觉得终于可以报靖康之耻的屈辱了！但无论如何，合作是这么定下来，至于结果如何，自然是不用多说！
这个世界的蒙古本就不如历史上，更何况铁木真的几个儿子明争暗斗，宋蒙联合的时间又比原来早了很多，杨康根本不怕！
大宋冗兵问题那么严重，只能提供后勤，最终的主战场的战斗力还是要看蒙古的！
忠于大宋的郭靖自然也得到了消息，他虽然对军事一窍不通，但武穆遗书却在他的手上！郭靖毅然决然的回了蒙古，打算一起灭金，报靖康耻之仇！
黄蓉劝阻无果，只好陪着郭靖一起回了蒙古！
洪七公看着黄蓉的模样，彻彻底底的失望了！他不能对不起丐帮！于是从黄蓉手里面拿走了丐帮帮主信物打狗棒，重新坐上了帮主之位，然后开始给黄蓉收拾烂摊子！
黄蓉对于丐帮帮主之位倒是没什么留恋，倒也爽快的交出去了，然后就准备和郭靖一起回蒙古！
洪七公看着黄蓉的样子，出于师父的责任，还是劝道：“蓉儿，靖儿本就有婚约在身，如今他回蒙古，你陪着一起去，让他未婚妻看着怎么想？你父亲的颜面又何存！还是尽早......”
黄蓉当然知道自己此去一定会遇到郭母和华筝，听着自家师傅让自己放弃，黄蓉忍不住打断道：“我知道自己在做什么！我爱靖哥哥，他也爱我！我要去！师傅，丐帮我实在没精力了，抱歉！”
说完也不等洪七公说什么，直接就跑了出去追郭靖了！
洪七公看着远去的郭靖黄蓉，只觉得自己无奈极了！他是真的很想让黄蓉退出这段感情，毕竟蒙古公主和郭靖之间有父母之命媒妁之言，黄蓉什么都没有啊！
当日桃花岛上，黄药师可并没有同意这桩婚事，一旦他们三人的三角恋传播开来，影响最大的还是黄蓉啊！
其实原着中郭靖黄蓉之所以没有背负骂名，是因为解除婚约正值蒙古侵宋之时，加上郭母去世，郭靖又在襄阳抵御蒙古，大家都以为郭靖是为了大宋而放弃了金刀驸马，自然人人都称赞他们忠君爱国，但现在不一样啊！
蒙古公主是有婚约，有郭母的认可，占据了道义的一方，而郭靖是负心人，而黄蓉是插足者啊！洪七公之所以收回打狗棒，也有这方面的原因，毕竟丐帮的名声不能因为黄蓉而被败坏啊！
content_en:
Hong Qigong has indeed been in the world for a long time and has seen a lot, but he has never encountered such a thing!
To be fair, he, Huang Rong, and Guo Jing were all at fault in this matter. The only innocent person might be the Mongolian princess!
It was wrong for Guo Jing and Huang Rong to fall in love when they knew about the engagement, but when he went to Peach Blossom Island to propose marriage without knowing it, it was like Guo Jing stopped his wife and remarried!
People whose engagements are canceled usually don't have a good reputation, even if the other person is a Mongolian princess!
Although he only found out about it after the fact, he was Guo Jing's master and he did have to bear some responsibility! Usually before proposing a marriage, one would ask about each other's situation. He had become a bad person without realizing it! Thinking of this, Hong Qigong couldn't help but sigh!
Seeing Guo Jing and Huang Rong making so much noise, I just felt a headache!
Judging from Guo Jing's temperament, Guo's mother will not be a weak and opinionated person. She will not let her son bear the reputation of treachery! Huang Rong was sure that a person would never look back, otherwise she would not have contradicted her father that day! The Mongolian princess was deeply in love with Guo Jing, so how could she break off the engagement? It was such a bad deal between these three people, but she was the one who inadvertently acted as the promoter!
What's more, Guo Jing's six masters have a grudge against Peach Blossom Island, let alone their own apprentice marrying Huang Rong!
But in the end, Huang Rong relied on her intelligence to keep Guo Jing in the Central Plains. However, in this way, the affairs of the Beggar Clan were inevitably a little overwhelmed, and the Beggar Clan became even more chaotic!
Huang Rong's method can only delay, but does not solve the root of the problem at all! Apart from anything else, Guo's mother is still in Mongolia. How can Guo Jing not see his mother for the rest of his life?
It's a pity that Guo Jing can't understand Huang Rong's little tricks, but Hong Qigong can see clearly that Huang Rong's temperament clearly cannot afford the future of the Beggar Clan!
Thinking of what Huang Rong has caused these days, Hong Qigong is really worried! I couldn't help but regret that I had rushed the pass!
Yang Kang doesn't care about Guo Jing and Huang Rong's current situation. After all, he is very busy right now!
The trade routes in the Western Regions have been officially opened, his son is also growing vigorously, and Dajin's national power is booming. He is only waiting for an opportunity to start the final step.
At night, after Ouyang Ke finished what he was doing, he couldn't help but look at the moon in the sky, but he was filled with emotions!
He had nothing to do that day. The reason why he chose to join Prince Zhao's Mansion was just to make a career in the Central Plains and let his uncle see his abilities. However, things developed too fast later, which made him a little unexpected!
Thinking of this, Ouyang Ke couldn't help but murmured: "I didn't expect that I, Ouyang Ke, a prodigal son, would actually go on the road to compete in the world!"
However, Ouyang Ke is still satisfied with his current life. The injury on his leg has recovered, his martial arts has improved to a higher level, and Ouyang's family is also thriving due to his own efforts!
Ouyang Ke now has two goals left. One is to make White Camel Villa bigger and stronger, and the other is to take revenge on Guo Jing and Huang Rong!
Ouyang Ke is not a gentleman who repays evil with kindness. The consistent style of White Camel Villa is to retaliate against evil! He has never forgotten the despair of breaking his leg that day. The recent behavior of Guo Jing and Huang Rong also had his handiwork, but no one noticed it!
At this time, news suddenly spread that Mongolia and the Song Dynasty were joining forces to destroy the Jin Dynasty. This made many knowledgeable people in the Song Dynasty feel that a storm was coming! On that day, the Song Dynasty united with the Jin Dynasty to destroy the Liao Dynasty, and the Song Dynasty had successfully lost the north of the Yangtze River. Now that another alliance with the Mongolia and Mongolia is coming to destroy the Jin Dynasty, can the Song Dynasty still have a future? My lips are dead and my teeth are cold!
In fact, Temujin didn't want to join forces with the Song Dynasty at this time, but he had no choice, because the strength of the Song Dynasty was growing too fast! If this development continues, Mongolia's salt and iron tea will be controlled by the Jin Kingdom, and by then it will be too late to do anything!
Didn’t the Song Dynasty know that the lips are dead and the teeth are cold? You must know, after all, the lessons of our ancestors have been laid outThere!
But even if they don't unite with Mongolia, Dajin will not let them go! The original Jin Kingdom still needed to buy grain from the Song Dynasty to maintain domestic stability, but with the opening of the Western Regions trade route, the Jin Dynasty has got rid of this situation. Now the Song Dynasty is simply in a dilemma! It’s better to fight with Mongolia!
As the news that Song and Meng united to fight against the Jin came out, the Jianghu and the courts instantly fell silent! The knowledgeable people will naturally know the harm of this move, while the ignorant people just think that they can finally avenge the humiliation of Jingkang! But no matter what, the cooperation is so settled. As for the result, it goes without saying!
Mongolia in this world is not as good as in history. What's more, Temujin's sons are fighting openly and secretly, and Song and Mongolia united much earlier than before. Yang Kang is not afraid at all!
The problem of redundant troops in the Song Dynasty was so serious that it could only provide logistics. The final combat effectiveness of the main battlefield still depended on Mongolia!
Guo Jing, who was loyal to the Song Dynasty, naturally got the news. Although he knew nothing about military affairs, Wu Mu's suicide note was in his hands! Guo Jing resolutely returned to Mongolia, planning to destroy the gold together and avenge Jingkang's humiliation!
Huang Rong tried to dissuade her to no avail, so she had no choice but to accompany Guo Jing back to Mongolia!
Hong Qigong looked at Huang Rong's appearance and was completely disappointed! He can't be sorry to the beggars! So he took away the Beggar Clan leader's token, the dog-beating stick, from Huang Rong's hand, took the position of leader again, and then started to clean up Huang Rong's mess!
Huang Rong didn't have any nostalgia for the position of leader of the Beggar Clan, so she handed it over readily, and then prepared to return to Mongolia with Guo Jing!
Hong Qigong looked at Huang Rong. Out of his responsibility as a master, he advised him: "Rong'er, Jing'er is already engaged. Now that he has returned to Mongolia, what do you think if you go with him and let his fiancée watch? How can your father's face be saved? It's better to..." as soon as possible..."
Of course Huang Rong knew that she would meet Guo Mu and Hua Zheng when she went there. When her master asked her to give up, Huang Rong couldn't help but interrupt: "I know what I am doing! I love brother Jing, and he loves me too! I want to go! Master, I really don't have the energy, I'm sorry!"
After finishing speaking, he ran out to chase Guo Jing without waiting for Hong Qigong to say anything!
Hong Qigong looked at Guo Jing and Huang Rong walking away and felt helpless! He really wanted Huang Rong to quit this relationship. After all, the Mongolian princess and Guo Jing had been ordered by their parents to be a matchmaker, so Huang Rong had nothing!
That day on Peach Blossom Island, Huang Yaoshi did not agree to the marriage. Once the love triangle between the three of them spread, Huang Rong would have the greatest impact!
In fact, the reason why Guo Jing and Huang Rong did not suffer infamy in the original work was because the marriage contract was broken off at the time when the Mongols invaded the Song Dynasty. In addition, Guo Jing's mother died, and Guo Jing resisted the Mongols in Xiangyang. Everyone thought that Guo Jing gave up the Golden Sword Prince Consort for the sake of the Song Dynasty. Naturally, everyone praised them for being loyal and patriotic, but it is different now!
The Mongolian princess has a marriage contract and is recognized by Guo's mother, so she occupies the moral side, but Guo Jing is the betrayer, and Huang Rong is the meddler! The reason why Hong Qigong took back the dog-beating stick also had this reason. After all, the reputation of the Beggar Clan cannot be ruined because of Huang Rong!
